title: The torch >= 2.10 gate must stay in sync across the code, error message, docs and test skips
answers: what torch version is needed to load pt2 models with pickle disabled
why does pt2 load ask me to upgrade torch to 2.10
change minimum torch version for pickle-free pt2 loading
body:
Invariant: the minimum torch version for pt2 validation (2.10) appears in several places that must change together.
- mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_validate_pt2_archive_is_pickle_free holds the Version(torch.__version__) < Version("2.10") check and the 'Upgrade to `torch` >= 2.10' error text.
- docs/docs/classic-ml/tracking/pickle-free-models/index.mdx states the requirement in the PT2 requirements box, a global-configuration note and the summary table.
- tests/pytorch/test_pytorch_model_export.py has skipif markers at 2.10 and a test matching the message 'Upgrade to `torch` >= 2.10' that mocks torch.__version__ to 2.9.1.
The reason is that weights_only was bypassable before torch 2.6 (CVE-2025-32434) and had memory corruption before 2.10 (CVE-2026-24747). Changing the threshold in one place alone leaves the message, docs and tests wrong.
applies: Any change to the torch version gate for pt2 loading under MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false.
says: Loading an exported PyTorch model prompts to upgrade PyTorch when pickle is disabled.
Documentation and error prompts show conflicting minimum PyTorch versions for secure loading.
Require newer PyTorch releases to prevent memory corruption vulnerabilities during model loading.
Make the minimum supported PyTorch version consistent across security guides and warnings.
search: The minimum torch version (2.10) for pt2 pickle validation under MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false must stay synchronized across code, error messages, docs, and test skips. The gate is checked in mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_validate_pt2_archive_is_pickle_free, documented in docs/docs/classic-ml/tracking/pickle-free-models/index.mdx, and tested with skipif markers in tests/pytorch/test_pytorch_model_export.py. The 2.10 threshold avoids weights_only bypasses before torch 2.6 (CVE-2025-32434) and memory corruption before 2.10 (CVE-2026-24747).
